verification_instructions: Validate via manual file review and AST/grep checks. Confirm HTML structure is valid, JS follows existing patterns, CSS uses design tokens exclusively.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - just edit files directly. No npm install available.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - npm registry blocked. Cannot run npm install, npm build, or any network-dependent commands. Use NODE_OPTIONS='' prefix for any node commands. Validation is file-based only.
contribution_requirements: BEM CSS naming, design tokens from variables.css, IntersectionObserver for scroll reveals, mobile-first responsive design, reduced motion support, semantic HTML, aria attributes, no function >60 lines, no class >400 lines
key_patterns: Section controllers: constructor grabs element by ID, reveal() adds --visible class + removes aria-hidden + sets up IntersectionObserver, hide() reverses, destroy() disconnects observer. CSS: section hidden by default (opacity:0, transform), --visible class reveals it. Child elements use [data-reveal] attribute + __element--revealed class for progressive reveals. app.js imports controllers and calls reveal() on DOMContentLoaded.
directory_structure: Root: index.html, css/ (main.css imports all modules), js/ (app.js entry, sections/ for controllers), assets/, data/, docs/, public/
